key_points: Jefferies initiated coverage with a Buy rating, citing multi-year hyperscaler/telecom contracts and Corning’s optical business scaling into 2028.
Capital Group Dividend Value added ~$108M of Corning and ~40 ETFs net bought ~$48M, signaling institutional demand.
Bernstein maintained coverage but lowered its price target to $120, a modest negative offset.
Nvidia selloff and China export-control headlines are mostly sector noise with limited direct GLW impact.
GLW is up ~32.5% over the past year, so valuation is less cheap after the rally.
